properties.description: The hook is registered, its script exists, and running the REGISTERED command with a real Stop payload produces the block decision the harness consumes — plus silence when the loop was checked, and once-only firing (tools/test_nudge_path.py, 9 cases). The server's detection covers installed / absent / broken / unmalformed-settings (nudge.rs, 4 cases).
properties.findings: FOUND BY WRITING IT: the first version asserted a non-zero exit code and failed against a working hook — Stop hooks block by printing JSON and exiting 0, so the test had encoded the wrong contract.
properties.name: The registered hook command produces the block decision the harness consumes
